name: Date Cold Storage 2026

name: Date Cold Storage 2025
description: The 2025 season, closed out in March. Retained as the benchmark the current season is measured against.

name: Agriculture Land — Hyderabad
description: Farmland held for appreciation, with development spending on tube wells and levelling ahead of any sale.

name: Farm Leasing — Tando Allahyar
description: Held farmland leased to growers on annual and half-yearly terms. Income is rent; the land itself stays on the register.

name: Property Trading — Karachi
description: Plots and apartments bought below market and held for resale. Two disposals so far; three still held.

name: Gulshan Residency Construction
description: A six-apartment block on a plot acquired in 2025. Structure complete, finishing under way; units to be rented rather than sold.

name: Rental Portfolio — Hyderabad
description: Shops and apartments let on monthly tenancies. The steadiest cash flow in the portfolio and the smallest return.

name: Microfinance Portfolio 2026
description: Small business loans to shopkeepers, tailors and dairy holders on twelve-month terms, collected monthly in the field.

name: PSX Equity Portfolio
description: A concentrated holding in banks, fertiliser, cement and energy. Marked to a mock price feed in Phase 1.

name: Currency Holdings — USD & AED
description: Foreign currency held against rupee depreciation. Small, liquid, and deliberately not traded actively.

name: Machinery Rental — Tractors & Trolleys
description: Tractors, trolleys, a rotavator and a mini excavator hired out by the hour to growers and small contractors.

name: Hourly Workforce Services
description: Farm labour, drivers and machine operators supplied to customers by the hour. Margin is the spread between the charge rate and the wage.
